Read an AmpliconArchitect graph file

Source: R/episomal_ampliconsuite.R
read_ampliconsuite.Rd

Parses an AmpliconArchitect *_graph.txt into copy-number segments (from the sequence edges) and structural-variant junctions (from the discordant edges), the latter with a coordinate-invariant SV class. Chromosome names are accepted with or without a chr prefix.

Usage

read_ampliconsuite(graph_file)

Arguments

graph_file

Path to an AmpliconArchitect *_graph.txt.

Value

A list with two data.table::data.tables:

segments

chr, start, end, cn (predicted copy number).

junctions

cA,pA,sA and cB,pB,sB (the two breakends' chromosome/position/strand), jcn (junction predicted copy number), pe_support (number of supporting read pairs), homlen (breakpoint homology length, NA if absent), svclass (DUP/DEL/INV/TRA) and lo/hi (the lower/upper breakend coordinate).

Either table may have zero rows.

See also

call_episomal_from_ampliconsuite()
